description: Muskai — text-to-reels studio. Next.js frontend + Express API + Alibaba DashScope free-quota video models.
name: muskai

scripts.build: npm run build -w @muskai/shared && npm run build -w @muskai/api && npm run build -w @muskai/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @muskai/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @muskai/api" "npm run dev -w @muskai/web"
scripts.setup: npm run build -w @muskai/shared && npm run db:setup -w @muskai/api
